name: Radeon Pro W5700 row of the Radeon Pro W5000 series specification table (Wikipedia, citing AMD product page)
notes: Radeon Pro W5000 series table, W5700 (Navi 10) row, footnotes 102 and 103 pointing at the AMD professional-graphics product page and the TechPowerUp spec page. Quoted: launched 19 Nov 2019 at 799 USD, RDNA, TSMC N7, 10.3e9 transistors, 251 mm2, 2304:144:64 / 36 CU, base 1400 MHz boost 1880 MHz, memory 8 GB GDDR6 256-bit, memory bandwidth 448 GB/s, TDP 205 W, PCIe 4.0 x16. The AMD product page itself returned 404 on 2026-10-17, so the bandwidth and capacity are taken from this compiled table rather than a live vendor sheet, and confidence is capped.
